Action: Decide the report strategy and confirm the scope: Security + Availability + Confidentiality, AWS carved out, one system (the platform)
Note: Runs with ISO-02: one scope decision serves both frameworks

Action: Approve the system description and the CUEC schedule; publish the CUECs in the customer agreement and on the trust page
Note: No ISO action creates this. Closes OFI-10

Action: Establish an oversight arrangement independent of management: an advisory board seat, or a documented CEO-plus-external-adviser review of the system of internal control
Note: No ISO clause requires an independent governing body. Closes gate SG-2

Action: Add a fraud consideration to the risk assessment: fraudulent reporting, misappropriation of assets and corruption, with incentives, pressures, opportunities and rationalisations
Note: ISO/IEC 27001 Annex A has no fraud control. Closes OFI-11

Action: Publish service commitments and system requirements: uptime target, support response times and recovery objectives
Note: Without a commitment, Availability has nothing to be tested against. Closes OFI-12

Action: Map each control in the SoA to the criteria it serves and maintain the crosswalk as one control set
Note: Delivered in draft by CGI-SOC-001 Part 2; becomes a maintained artefact

Action: Stand up evidence capture: ticketing for access reviews, change approvals, incident records, restore tests and vendor reviews, so that a population exists to sample
Note: The single highest-value SOC 2 action. Closes OFI-06

Action: Select a CPA firm for the examination. It must be independent of whoever performed the readiness work, and different from the ISO certification body
Note: AICPA independence: the firm that builds controls cannot examine them

Action: Readiness re-assessment against the 38 criteria using this workbook
Note: Re-run the scoring; target every gate PASS

Action: Type I examination as of 31 March 2028
Note: Planning estimate for a 50-person single-system scope

Action: Type II observation period: 1 April 2028 to 30 September 2028
Note: Six months is the market norm for a first Type II

Action: Type II examination and report issue
Note: Planning estimate. Certificate equivalent: the report, issued ~Nov 2028

Action: Publish a trust page carrying the ISO certificate, the SOC 2 status and the CUEC schedule
Note: Answers the buyers who are asking today

Action: Bridge statement covering the gap between the Type II period end and a buyer's due diligence date
Note: The gap CGI itself found in a vendor (F-006, stale Slack SOC 2) - do not repeat it
